data_points.source_name: MFDS (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety) press release, '24년 화장품 생산·수출액 모두 사상 최대실적 기록 (2025-05-27)
data_points.notes: PRODUCTION VALUE, not retail and not export. MFDS annex table 3: 인체 세정용 제품류 (personal/body cleansing product type) KRW 20,770억 in 2024 (= KRW 2.077tn; USD 1.405bn @ 1478.40 USD/KRW pinned 2026-07-21), 11.8% of total cosmetics production, third-largest type. 2023 comparator KRW 18,902억. SCOPE CAVEAT: 인체 세정용 is WIDER than bath & shower — it bundles facial foam cleansers with body wash and soap. The MFDS release itself breaks out 폼클렌저 + 기타 세정용 at KRW 8,855억 (2024), i.e. ~43% of the type is cleanser-led rather than bath/shower, so bath & shower proper is materially smaller than KRW 2.077tn. A separate, much narrower MFDS line 목욕용 제품류 (bath preparations) is only KRW 130억 in 2024 (down from KRW 178억 in 2023). Domestic manufacture only; excludes imports.

data_points.methodology: Computed from the two adjacent-year values printed in MFDS annex table 3 for 인체 세정용 제품류: KRW 18,902억 (2023) to KRW 20,770억 (2024) = +9.88%. Same PRODUCTION basis both years, same official table, no normalisation needed. Sensitivity: none on the arithmetic; definitional uncertainty only (type is wider than bath & shower, see notes).
data_points.notes: WARNING on a widely repeated misreading: the MFDS narrative text says 인체세정용 제품 grew '+30.0%, +2,045억원', but that +30.0% attaches to the 폼클렌저/기타 세정용 SUB-LINE (KRW 6,810억 to 8,855억), not to the 인체 세정용 type as a whole. The type total in annex table 3 grew 18,902억 to 20,770억 = +9.88%. Korean trade press (e.g. Cosmorning's write-up of the same release) reproduces the +30.0% against the whole type, which is wrong. 9.88% is the figure supported by the table.

'The South Korea market size for bath products reached a value of more than USD 357.35 Million in 2025.' SCOPE CAVEAT: EMR's 'bath products' scope (shower gel/bubble wash, bath salts, bar soap, bath bombs and capsules) is narrower than a full bath & shower segment and its relationship to the MFDS 인체 세정용 production line is unclear. Basis assumed retail sell-through; EMR does not state basis, channel coverage, or duty-free treatment. Do not compare with the MFDS KRW 2.077tn production figure without normalising — different measure (rule 11) and different scope.

EMR: USD 357.35mn (2025) to USD 439.90mn (2035), CAGR 2.10% between 2026 and 2035. Trajectory is internally consistent (357.35 x 1.021^10 = 440). Low single-digit forecast contrasts with the +9.88% CY2024 production growth on the MFDS 인체 세정용 line — different measure and different scope, do not reconcile.
